content_blocks.title: Work through the example
content_blocks.text: Read the small example, predict every output line, then run it locally with a compatible runtime. The module table/return is illustrative; save the file on package.path before calling require. Keep the smallest reproducible case if the observed behavior differs.

content_blocks.code:
-- In a module file, expose a small public interface.
local M = {}
function M.double(n) return n * 2 end
return M
-- A caller can use: local mathx = require("mathx")
